version.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes made to core logic or documentation in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: This is a simple review-style skill that only tells the agent how to spot over-engineering in diffs.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires only access to the user-provided diff being reviewed and does not ask to read broad local files, credentials, sessions, or private stores.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown SKILL.md file with no bundled executable scripts, dependency installation, or remote payload retrieval instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally narrows review scope to over-engineering and excludes correctness, security, and performance; this is disclosed and coherent with its purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, tool wrapping, memory writing, or system modification behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to review diffs for unnecessary complexity, and the artifact only contains guidance for producing concise review findings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a terse, deletion-focused review mode for over-engineering. Do not treat it as a complete code review because it explicitly excludes security, correctness, and performance analysis.
